- Clarification on how channel margin flows to our distributor (Skyfall Resellers) vs reseller network

Subject: Re: Hybrid bundle pricing for BrightLayer — request for discount bands + channel evidence

James — thanks, great to hear. Attaching a first-pass pricing workbook (BL_hybrid_pricing_v1.xlsx). Quick notes below and next steps.

Summary (high level)
- Tiered committed discount: 5% @ $250k ARR, 12% @ $750k, 20% @ $1.5M (applies to token/instance unit pricing across both AWS and GCP SKUs)
- Distributor (Skyfall) pass-through: we support a reseller pass-through flow; recommended cap on distributor uplift is 18% to preserve unit economics
- Invoice pathing: two options — (1) AWS/GCP Marketplace private offer (BrightLayer billed via marketplace; reseller receives commission/credit) or (2) Redwood invoice (direct) with reseller rebate evidence and netback. Marketplace flow gives simpler procurement but requires reseller accreditation evidence for pass-through.

Requested evidence for channel pass-through (what we'd need from Skyfall):
- Signed reseller agreement with BrightLayer or Skyfall's master reseller contract
- W-9 or local tax equivalents
- Example invoice or commission statement showing prior pass-through handling
- Distributor VAT/exemption certificates (if applicable)

I've cc'd Sales Ops (Ben) to align on distributor uplifts and invoice mapping. Next steps: Ben will confirm acceptable distributor cap and Connor will help with the private offer SKU mapping. I'll follow up with a draft private offer terms doc and a timeline.

Attachments: BL_hybrid_pricing_v1.xlsx

Best,

Subject: Re: Hybrid bundle pricing for BrightLayer — distributor margin notes

Kim / team — quick internal note on channel math and operational constraints. Replying inline.

> - Distributor (Skyfall) pass-through: we support a reseller pass-through flow; recommended cap on distributor uplift is 18% to preserve unit economics

18% is reasonable as a maximum for this band, but recommend we tier distributor uplifts by commit size to avoid margin erosion. Suggested mapping:
- Commit < $500k: distributor cap = 18%
- Commit $500k–$1.5M: distributor cap = 14%
- Commit > $1.5M: distributor cap = 10%

Operational notes:
- If BrightLayer requests marketplace billing, AWS private offer needs reseller mapping (Skyfall must be registered as reseller in the offer metadata). That creates a two-step reconciliation (AWS -> Skyfall -> BrightLayer) so we'll need invoice samples to validate the pathing.
- If BrightLayer prefers Redwood invoicing (direct), we can apply an offline rebate to Skyfall — this is simpler for marketplace SKUs that don't support reseller fields, but requires a signed rebate addendum.

Connor: can you start a SKU mapping doc for the two core SKUs James referenced in demo (node-hour compute + managed ingestion)? Laura: can you prepare a sample rebate addendum template we can attach if BrightLayer opts for direct invoicing.

Ben Carter
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
